legal_name: KU INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED (as claimed; not verified against MCA)
note: Registry data could not be verified. All 10 tool calls failed to yield a usable source: web_search returned connection refused (searx backend down); Bing returned only irrelevant US results (University of Kansas, LG&E-KU) for every query variant including site:zaubacorp.com / site:tofler.in / site:thecompanycheck.com; zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com and mca.gov.in returned HTTP 403; instafinancials.com returned HTTP 404; Google returned HTTP 429; DuckDuckGo timed out. Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered state, MCA status and revenue are all null — NOT because they are absent, but because no public source was reachable. No rejection is applied: non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy is NOT established, and per project rules rejection requires positive evidence of one of those. Role left as 'unknown' — no evidence of manufacturing plant or trading activity was obtained. Declared HS 848190 (parts of taps/valves for pipes/boilers) and claimed industry 'oil & gas and chemicals' are unverified and were not used as a basis for any verdict. Recommended action: re-run verification when search backend is restored, or obtain the company's CIN/GSTIN directly from the supplier and check on mca.gov.in Master Data and the GST portal.
